name: POWER FROM PAIN
text: After a Hand of the Archon operative acts, it gains one Pain token if an enemy became injured (and not incapacitated) during that action, or an enemy was incapacitated; two tokens if that enemy had a Wounds stat of 12 or more. Pain tokens stay on the operative until spent, one at a time, on invigorations: Dark Animus, Accelerated Rejuvenation, Vitalised Surge and Stimulated Senses. At most one invigoration per activation or counteraction, with Stimulated Senses allowed on top.

name: RIFLES
text: A splinter rifle has Accurate 1 while its bearer shoots in an activation in which it has not made a Charge, Fall Back or Reposition. Doing those after shooting is still fine.

name: Tangle
text: While fighting or retaliating with this weapon, each of your blocks may cancel two of the enemy's unresolved successes instead of one.

name: Stinger
text: When an enemy is incapacitated by this weapon, before it is removed, every other operative (friend or foe) that can see it within 2 inches takes D3 damage, rolled separately. Any operative incapacitated by this damage bursts in the same way.

name: Flay
text: The first time in a fight that the wielder strikes with a critical success using this weapon, you may pick a friendly Hand of the Archon operative within 6 inches of it (itself included) to gain a Pain token.

name: Cunning
text: In the Gambit step, if the Archsybarite is in the killzone and you pass at the first opportunity, you gain 1 CP. A gambit from the mission pack used first does not spoil it; a team strategy ploy used first does.

name: Torturous Vision
text: Once in each of its own activations, if the Archsybarite holds no Pain token when it performs Shoot or Fight, it can gain one as the target (or the enemy to fight) is chosen.

name: Sadistic Competition
text: Once per turning point, when a friendly Hand of the Archon operative gains a Pain token, one friendly Agent that holds none gains one too (the engine picks the closest).

name: Brutal Display
text: Once per turning point, when the Duellist incapacitates an enemy within its control range, pick another enemy that is visible to and within 6 inches of the Duellist or of the fallen enemy. Until the next turning point starts it cannot control markers or perform Pick Up Marker or mission actions.

name: Crimson Duellist
text: The Duellist may perform two Fight actions in its activation.

name: TORMENT GRENADE
text: Pick an enemy the Disciple can see within 6 inches. That enemy and every other operative within 1 inch of it, friend or foe, takes a poison test: roll a D6, adding 1 if its Save is 4+ or worse; on a 3 or more it takes D3 damage and gains one of your Poison tokens if it has none. A Poison-token holder takes D3 damage whenever it is activated. Not usable inside an enemy control range.

name: Combat Drugs
text: When the kill team is chosen with an Elixicant in it, pick one combat drug: Painbringer, Adrenalight or Hypex. Every friendly Hand of the Archon operative has it for the battle, until Administer Drug changes one operative's dose. The drugs outlast the Elixicant.

name: Painbringer
text: COMBAT DRUG. Whenever one attack die would inflict 3 or more damage on this operative, roll a D6; on a 6 that die's damage is reduced by 1.

name: Adrenalight
text: COMBAT DRUG. In the Ready step of each Strategy phase, one friendly operative with this drug gains a Pain token (the engine picks the one with the fewest).

name: Hypex
text: COMBAT DRUG. The operative ignores the Move loss from being injured. Its Hit still worsens while injured.

name: ADMINISTER DRUG
text: Pick a friendly Hand of the Archon operative that the Elixicant can see within 3 inches (itself included). Either it regains up to 2D3 lost wounds, or its combat drug is replaced by a different one for the rest of the battle. Not usable inside an enemy control range.

name: Insensible to Pain
text: A weapon's Normal or Critical Dmg of 3 or more deals 1 less to the Flayer. Devastating, Stinger, poison and other non-weapon damage is not reduced.

name: Merciless Hunter
text: If the Assassin does not perform MARK in an activation, it may Shoot twice, once with the razorwing and once with another weapon.

name: Omen
text: Once, as the first Firefight phase begins, name an enemy operative or another friendly Hand of the Archon operative. Dice rolled for an enemy pick have every 6 re-rolled at once; for a friendly pick you may re-roll any 1s. It lasts the whole battle.

name: MARK
text: Pick an enemy the Assassin can see. Until the end of the turning point, when the Assassin shoots it, its ranged weapons have Seek Light and the enemy cannot be obscured. Not usable inside an enemy control range.
